title: Laumufarþegi component diagram
description: Laumufarþegi: an Icelandic online party word game for 3–10 players on their own devices. A plain-TypeScript page shows each player their view; one Cloudflare Worker serves it and runs one Durable Object per room, which decides everything with the shared rules. Topics come from the repository's shared word lists.

components.name: Laumufarþegi
components.responsibility: One game: the page, the Worker with its rooms, the shared code and the tests, built and deployed together as one npm project.

components.name: Shared code
components.responsibility: The rules (the Phase machine, scoring, per-player views), the WebSocket protocol and the topics.

components.name: Worker and rooms
components.responsibility: The routes, the sign-in for starting a room, and the Room Durable Object.

components.name: Browser page
components.responsibility: The screens and the connection to the room.

components.name: Tests
components.responsibility: node:test suites for the rules (game.test.ts), the Room on a fake runtime (room.test.ts) and the Worker's routes (worker.test.ts), bundled by build.mjs --test.

components.name: Icelandic word lists
components.responsibility: The 16-word topic grids, shared with other party games; not a game itself.

components.name: Sign-in (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: icelander.net's shared sign-in library, copied in and never edited here.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in, and their games: roles.
